remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully updated raised ranch, offering modern style, thoughtful updates, and a move-in-ready condition. The main level features three spacious bedrooms and a beautifully updated full bath, with durable LVP flooring flowing throughout for a cohesive look. The inviting living room, dining room and kitchen offer an open and comfortable flow while still having defined spaces. There are cathedral beadboard ceilings throughout the main level, and an abundance of natural light from the many windows.

The kitchen opens to a delightful sunroom/three-season room, creating an ideal space for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying the views of the professionally landscaped yard. From the sunroom, step out onto the spacious deck for easy outdoor living.

The finished lower level adds valuable living space and versatility, featuring full egress with large windows and a door to the exterior. One spacious room could serve as a recreation room, home office, or potential primary bedroom, with an adjoining storage area that would make an excellent walk-in closet. An updated half bath with modern finishes, convenient laundry room, entry area with a large closet, and one-car garage complete this level. The assessor has the square footage of 1,152 which is the upper level only. The total square footage noted in the listing includes 582 square feet of finished area in the lower level that has egress. 

Outside, enjoy a large, professionally landscaped yard, spacious deck, and storage shed. Located on a quiet dead-end street while still being conveniently close to area amenities. Central air adds year-round comfort. With its extensive updates, flexible finished lower level, and excellent condition, this home is truly ready for you to move right in and enjoy!
